title: 第14章  妖女的眼泪与算盘
slug: 让你当炉做鼎你炼阴阳证大道
content_zh:
李寒山看着眼前这个哭成泪人的小姑娘，心中五味陈杂。
他伸手揉了揉她的脑袋，温声道：“傻孩子，说什么胡话呢。”
“可是......”
“没有可是。”
李寒山打断他：“这事我会自己想办法，你好好跟着江长老修炼，早日把修为提上来。”
“李爷爷，要不你亲我也行，像上次....”
许灵溪话说到一半，被一阵轻盈的脚步声打断。
花弄影从山路上走来，红衣似火，烟杆在手，慵懒中透着几分妖娆。
她的目光在许灵溪身上扫过，似笑非笑：“哟，这不是江长老新收的高徒嘛，怎么有空来我这小院子了？”
许灵溪下意识有些紧张，随即她挺起胸膛，一脸认真的警告：“花师姐，你不许伤害李爷爷！否则我将来饶不了你！”
花弄影摇曳着走过来，亲昵地挽住李寒山的胳膊：“小妹妹，你说什么呢？我怎么会伤害他呀，他可是我的心上人呢～”
许灵溪轻哼：“你骗人，我才不信！”
花弄影轻笑着调侃：“小妹妹，你倒是挺关心他的嘛。不过呢，他有我照顾，不劳你费心啦～”
“你！”
许灵溪气得小脸通红，她跺跺脚，狠狠瞪了花弄影一眼，又看向李寒山，眼眶红红的：“李爷爷，你等我，我一定救你出去！”
说完，她转身就离开，眨眼间便消失在山路尽头。
花弄影看着许灵溪离去的背影，嗤笑一声，转头看向李寒山，语气突然变得认真：“主人，你可别碰这小丫头。”
李寒山眉头一挑：“为什么？”
花弄影凑近了些：“她是江长老的宝贝徒弟，江长老肯定在她身上下了禁制，谁碰谁死。主人你若是不信邪，大可以试试，不过奴家可不想给你收尸。”
李寒山心中一凛。

他倒没想过要碰许灵溪，但花弄影这番话，倒是提醒了他，江念微这等金丹修士，随便一点什么小手段，都足以要了他的命。
“我知道了。”
他点点头，不动声色地转移话题：“刚才灵溪跟我说，炉鼎可以转为正式弟子。”
花弄影眼神微闪，却没有接话。
“我想试试。”
李寒山看着她的眼睛：“我想成为合欢宗的正式弟子。”
花弄影沉默几秒，嫣然一笑：“主人想做什么，奴家自然全力支持。”
她挽着他的胳膊，一边往院子里走，一边说：“主人放心，这次宗门大考的秘境试炼，奴家会带你一起进去。有奴家在，主人一定可以成功。”
李寒山心中一动。
她居然主动提出要带他进秘境？
“你不是要争夺第一吗？带着我，不怕拖累？”他试探道。
花弄影眼波流转，轻笑一声：“主人太小看奴家了。就算带着主人，奴家也有把握夺得第一。”
这话说得自信满满，李寒山却从中嗅到了一丝别样的味道。
这妖女，怕是另有打算。
回到房间后，花弄影拉着李寒山坐到床边，认真道：“主人，离宗门大考还有一个多月。这段时间，奴家要帮你把修为再提一提。”
李寒山看着她：“你不想突破筑基了？”
花弄影听到他的话，眼底闪过一丝喜意，却很快将其掩藏。转而叹了口气，眼中闪过一丝落寞：“当然想，但筑基哪有那么容易呢？”
她抬起头，脸上重新挂起笑容：“放心吧主人，奴家有把握。就算不突破筑基，也能夺得第一，保住内门弟子身份。当务之急，还是先提升主人的修为，让主人拥有更强的实力。”
李寒山心中冷笑。
说得倒是好听，无非是想让他放松警惕，直到她的魅术彻底控制他为止。

不过，这正是他想要的。
“好，那就辛苦你了。”
他伸手揽住花弄影的腰，低头在她唇上亲了一口。
花弄影嘤咛一声，软软地靠进他怀里。
罗帐垂下，烛火摇曳。
接下来的日子，两人几乎天天修炼。
李寒山每次都会悄无声息地从花弄影体内汲取一些本源，加速阳纹花开。与此同时，他的修为也在稳步提升。
一天，两天，三天.....
一个月的时间，在修炼中悄然流逝。
花弄影灵石用得差不多了，药汤也断了，连丹药都所剩无几。但李寒山的修为，却从炼气七层突破到了炼气八层巅峰，离九层只有一步之遥。
她相当于自己修炼，再让李寒山汲取，以自己来养他。
“呼！”
李寒山长长吐出一口浊气，睁开眼。
他的腹部微微发热，神识探入其中，只见那朵金花已经有两片花瓣完全绽开。
第三片，也开了一半。
“可惜，不敢太快。”
李寒山心中暗道。
每次他都不敢汲取太多本源，避免被花弄影察觉。
“主人，你越来越强了呢～”
花弄影从身后环住他的腰，下巴搁在他肩上，声音软糯：“再这样下去，用不了多久，主人就能超过奴家了。”

李寒山笑了笑：“还不是你的功劳。”
花弄影松开手，从储物袋里掏出一把长剑，递到李寒山面前。
“主人，这是奴家给你买的飞剑。虽然不是什么名贵货色，但用来御剑飞行与简单的战斗，足够了。”
李寒山接过飞剑，剑身冰凉，泛着淡淡的寒光。
“好剑！”
他赞了一声。
花弄影得意地扬起下巴：“那当然，奴家挑了好久呢～”
接下来，花弄影手把手地教李寒山御剑之术。
从如何将灵力灌入飞剑，到如何控制飞剑飞行，再到如何施展简单的剑诀，她教得耐心细致，李寒山也学得飞快。
仅仅小半天，他便能踩着飞剑在院子周围飞行了。
“主人真聪明～”
花弄影在旁边拍手叫好，眼中满是崇拜。
这时，一道遁光从天际划过，落在院子外面。来人是个年轻女子，容貌清丽，气质冷傲。
“花弄影，出来！”
女子的声音冷得像冰碴子。
花弄影从房间里走出来，看到来人，脸色微变，冷声道：“云疏月？你来做什么？”
云疏月打量了她一眼，露出嘲弄之色：“哟，还在炼气圆满呢？我还以为你早就筑基了呢。”
花弄影脸色一沉：“关你什么事？”
“当然关我的事。”
云疏月慢悠悠地走过来，筑基期的威压毫不掩饰地释放出来：“你不是一直自诩天才吗？怎么，连筑基都突破不了？看来，你也不过如此嘛。”

花弄影咬着唇，没有说话。
云疏月继续道：“我劝你啊，这次宗门大考还是别去了。就你这点修为，去了也是丢人现眼。”
说完，她冷笑一声，转身离去，遁光消失在天空中。
花弄影站在原地，肩膀微微颤抖。
李寒山走到她身边，发现她的眼眶红红的，眼泪在打转，却强忍着没有掉下来。
“你没事吧？”他问。
“没事。”
花弄影摇了摇头，声音有些哽咽：“主人，我.....我想一个人待一会儿。”
她转身走进里间，关上了门。
李寒山看着那扇紧闭的门，心中冷笑：“在这里等着我是吧？”
花弄影的伤心，未必全是假的。但她的目的，李寒山看得一清二楚，无非是想让他心疼，让他主动提出帮她突破筑基。
若不是丫头点醒，他现在应该已经彻底沦陷，恐怕真会中招。
“既然你想演，那我就陪你演。”
李寒山走到房门前，轻轻敲了敲。
“弄影，开门。”
里面没有回应。
他又敲了敲：“我有话跟你说。”
片刻后，门开了。
花弄影站在门口，眼睛红红的，脸上还挂着泪痕，看起来楚楚可怜。
“主人……”

她低着头，看上去我见犹怜。
李寒山伸手捧起她的脸，轻轻擦去她脸上的泪痕，温声道：“别难过了。要不我帮你突破筑基吧？”
花弄影猛地抬起头，眼中闪过一抹惊喜，但很快又黯淡下去。
她摇了摇头，语气坚定：“不行。主人你的修为还没到九层，马上就要进秘境了，不能耽误。”
“可是......”
“没有可是。”
花弄影打断他，挤出一个笑容：“主人，奴家没事的。云疏月说得对，我确实不如她。但这没关系，我会努力的，总有一天会超过她。”
李寒山看着她，心中暗笑。
演技不错，可惜，我已经看穿了。
“好吧，那就后面再说。”
他叹了口气，语气中带着几分遗憾。
花弄影愣了一下，眼中闪过一丝错愕。
她张了张嘴，似乎想说什么，却又咽了回去。
“主人，我们继续修炼吧。”她勉强笑了笑。
李寒山点头：“好。”
两人回到房间，花弄影主动靠了过来，表现得比以往更加热情。
但李寒山能清晰感知到，她的心绪乱成一团，有疑惑，有不甘，还有一丝.....愤怒。
“怎么回事？他怎么不按套路来？”
花弄影在心中大骂。
按照她的设想，李寒山此时中魅术已深，应该心疼她，主动帮她突破筑基。到时候她半推半就，顺势而为，便能一举筑基，摆脱心魔誓约的束缚。

可现在，李寒山居然“后面再说”了！
“难道我的魅术失效了？不可能啊......”
她百思不得其解，却又没有表现出来，继续扮演温柔体贴的小女奴。
李寒山感受着她心中的疑惑和愤怒，嘴角微微上扬。
这妖女算计了他这么久，终于也尝到了被算计的滋味。
不过，花弄影很快就调整了心态。
“没关系，秘境才是关键。”
她在心中冷笑：“你以为不帮我筑基，就能逃出我的手掌心？只要进了秘境，我看你还怎么逃！”
content_en:
Li Hanshan looked at the little girl crying in front of him with mixed feelings in his heart.
He stretched out his hand to rub her head and said warmly: "Silly boy, what nonsense are you talking about."
"But..."
"No buts."
Li Hanshan interrupted him: "I will figure this out myself. You should practice well with Elder Jiang and improve your cultivation as soon as possible."
"Grandpa Li, how about you kiss me, like last time..."
Xu Lingxi was interrupted by the sound of light footsteps mid-sentence.
Hua Nongying walked up the mountain road, her red clothes were like fire, and she held a cigarette stick in her hand, showing a bit of enchantment in her laziness.
Her eyes swept over Xu Lingxi, half-smiling but not smiling: "Hey, isn't this Elder Jiang's new apprentice? How come you have time to come to my little courtyard?"
Xu Lingxi was a little nervous subconsciously, and then she puffed out her chest and warned seriously: "Senior Sister Hua, you are not allowed to hurt Grandpa Li! Otherwise I will not be able to spare you in the future!"
Hua Nongying swayed over and took Li Hanshan's arm affectionately: "Little sister, what are you talking about? How could I hurt him? He is my sweetheart~"
Xu Lingxi hummed: "You are lying, I don't believe you!"
Hua Nongying chuckled and teased: "Little sister, you do care about him. But, he is taken care of by me, so I don't need you to worry~"
"You!"
Xu Lingxi's face turned red with anger. She stamped her feet, glared at Hua Nongying, and then looked at Li Hanshan with red eyes: "Grandpa Li, wait for me, I will definitely save you!"
After saying that, she turned around and left, disappearing at the end of the mountain road in the blink of an eye.
Hua Nongying looked at Xu Lingxi's leaving back, sneered, turned to look at Li Hanshan, and her tone suddenly became serious: "Master, please don't touch this little girl."
Li Hanshan raised his eyebrows: "Why?"
Hua Nongying came closer: "She is Elder Jiang's precious apprentice. Elder Jiang must have placed a restriction on her. Whoever touches her will die. Master, if you don't believe in evil, you can try it, but the slave family doesn't want to collect your body."
Li Hanshan was shocked.
He had never thought about touching Xu Lingxi, but Hua Nongying's words reminded him that any small trick by a Jindan cultivator like Jiang Nianwei could kill him.
"I understand."
He nodded and calmly changed the subject: "Lingxi just told me that Lu Ding can become a formal disciple."
Hua Nongying's eyes flashed slightly, but she didn't answer.
"I want to try."
Li Hanshan looked into her eyes: "I want to become an official disciple of the Hehuan Sect."
Hua Nongying was silent for a few seconds, then smiled sweetly: "Whatever the master wants to do, the slave family will naturally support it fully."
She held his arm and walked into the yard while saying: "Master, don't worry, this time the slave family will take you in the secret trial of the sect's big exam. With the slave family here, master will definitely succeed."
Li Hanshan's heart moved.
She actually offered to take him into the secret realm?
"Aren't you going to compete for the first place? Take me with you, and you won't be afraid of being dragged down?" he asked tentatively.
Hua Nongying's eyes flashed and she chuckled: "Master underestimates the slave family. Even with the master, the slave family is sure to win the first place."
He said this with confidence, but Li Hanshan smelled something different from it.
This witch may have other plans.
After returning to the room, Hua Nongying pulled Li Hanshan to sit by the bed and said seriously: "Master, there is still more than a month before the sect's big exam. During this time, the slave family will help you improve your cultivation."
Li Hanshan looked at her: "You don't want to break through the foundation building?"
When Hua Nongying heard his words, a hint of joy flashed in her eyes, but she quickly hid it. Then he sighed, a trace of loneliness flashed in his eyes: "Of course I want to, but how can it be so easy to build a foundation?"
She raised her head and put a smile on her face again: "Don't worry, Master, the slave family is confident. Even if you don't break through the foundation building, you can still win the first place and keep your status as an inner disciple.. The most urgent task is to improve the master's cultivation first so that the master can have stronger strength. "
Li Hanshan sneered in his heart.
It sounds nice, but she just wants him to relax his vigilance until her charm completely controls him.
But that's exactly what he wanted.
"Okay, thank you for your hard work. "
He put his arms around Hua Nongying's waist, lowered his head and kissed her on the lips.
Hua Nongying let out a cry and leaned softly into his arms.
The tent was lowered and the candlelight flickered.
In the following days, the two practiced almost every day.
Li Hanshan would quietly absorb some of the essence from Hua Nongying's body every time to speed up the blooming of the Yang Pattern Flower. At the same time, his cultivation level was also steadily improving.
One day, two days, three days...
A month passed quietly while practicing.
The Hua Nongying Spiritual Stone is almost used, the medicinal soup is also gone, and there is not much left of the elixir. But Li Hanshan's cultivation level has broken through from the seventh level of Qi refining to the peak of the eighth level, only one step away from the ninth level.
She was equivalent to cultivating herself, then letting Li Hanshan absorb it, and raising him with herself.
"Huh! "
Li Hanshan let out a long breath and opened his eyes.
His abdomen felt slightly warm, and when his spiritual consciousness penetrated it, he saw that two petals of the golden flower had fully bloomed.
The third piece was also half opened.
“Unfortunately, I dare not go too fast. "
Li Hanshan thought to himself.
Every time, he didn't dare to absorb too much of his origin to avoid being noticed by Hua Nongying.
"Master, you are getting stronger and stronger~"
Hua Nongying hugged his waist from behind, rested her chin on his shoulder, and said in a soft voice: "If this continues, it won't be long before the master can surpass the slave. "
Li Hanshan smiled: "It's not your fault. "
Hua Nongying let go of her hand, took out a long sword from her storage bag, and handed it to Li Hanshan.
"Master, this is the flying sword that the slave family bought for you. Although it is not an expensive item, it is enough for flying with a sword and simple combat. "
Li Hanshan took the flying sword. The sword was cold and glowed with a faint cold light.
"What a sword! "
He praised.
Hua Nongying raised her chin proudly: "Of course, I have been choosing for a long time~"
Next, Hua Nongying taught Li Hanshan the art of sword control step by step.
From how to pour spiritual power into a flying sword, to how to control the flying sword, to how to perform simple sword techniques, she taught her patiently and meticulously, and Li Hanshan also learned quickly.
In just half a day, he was able to fly around the yard on his flying sword.
"Master is so smart~"
Hua Nongying clapped her hands and applauded beside her, her eyes filled with admiration.
At this time, a ray of light flashed across the sky and fell outside the courtyard. The person who came was a young woman with a beautiful appearance and a cold and arrogant temperament.
"Hua Nongying, come out! "
The woman's voice was as cold as ice.
Hua Nongying walked out of the room, saw the person coming, her face changed slightly, and she said coldly: "Yun Shuyue? What are you doing here? "
Yun Shuyue looked at her with a mocking look: "Hey, are you still refining your Qi to perfection? I thought you had already established the foundation. "
Hua Nongying's face darkened: "What does it have to do with you? "
"Of course it's none of my business. "
Yun Shuyue walked over slowly, unabashedly releasing the pressure of the Foundation Establishment Stage: "Don't you always think of yourself as a genius? Why, you can't even break through the foundation building? It seems that you are nothing more than that. "
Hua Nongying bit her lip and said nothing.
Yun Shuyue continued: "I advise you not to go to the sect's big exam this time. With your little cultivation, it would be embarrassing to go there. "
After saying that, she sneered, turned and left, disappearing into the sky.
Hua Nongying stood there, her shoulders shaking slightly.
Li Hanshan walked to her and found that her eyes were red and tears were rolling, but she resisted falling.
"Are you okay? he asked.
"It's okay. "
Hua Nongying shook her head, her voice choked with sobs: "Master, I... I want to be alone for a whileSon. "
She turned and walked into the inner room and closed the door.
Li Hanshan looked at the closed door and sneered in his heart: "Wait for me here, right? "
Hua Nongying's sadness may not all be fake. But Li Hanshan saw clearly her purpose, which was simply to make him feel distressed and make him offer to help her break through the foundation.
If it hadn't been for the girl to wake him up, he would have been completely defeated by now, and he might really have been tricked.
"Since you want to act, then I will act with you. "
Li Hanshan walked to the door and knocked gently.
"Nongying, open the door. "
There was no response from inside.
He knocked again: “I have something to tell you. "
After a while, the door opened.
Hua Nongying stood at the door with red eyes and tears on her face, looking pitiful.
"Master..."
She lowered her head, looking pitiful to me.
Li Hanshan reached out to hold her face, gently wiped away the tears on her face, and said warmly: "Don't be sad. How about I help you break through the foundation building? "
Hua Nongying raised her head suddenly, a flash of surprise flashed in her eyes, but it quickly dimmed again.
She shook her head and said firmly: "No. Master, your cultivation has not reached the ninth level yet, and you are about to enter the secret realm. You cannot delay. "
"But..."
“No buts. "
Hua Nongying interrupted him and forced a smile: "Master, everything is fine. Yun Shuyue is right, I am indeed not as good as her. But it doesn't matter, I will work hard and one day I will surpass her. "
Li Hanshan looked at her and smiled secretly in his heart.
The acting is good, but unfortunately, I have seen through it.
"Okay, let's talk about it later. "
He sighed, a hint of regret in his tone.
Hua Nongying was stunned for a moment, a trace of astonishment flashed in her eyes.
She opened her mouth, as if she wanted to say something, but swallowed it back.
"Master, let's continue practicing. ” She forced a smile.
Li Hanshan nodded: "Okay. "
The two returned to the room, and Hua Nongying took the initiative to come closer, acting more enthusiastic than before.
But Li Hanshan could clearly sense that her mind was in a mess, with doubts, unwillingness, and a trace of... anger.
"What's going on? Why didn't he follow the routine? "
Hua Nongying cursed in her heart.
According to her assumption, Li Hanshan was already under the spell of enchantment, so he should feel sorry for her and take the initiative to help her break through the foundation. When the time comes, she half-promises, and follows the trend, and she will be able to build a foundation in one fell swoop and get rid of the shackles of the inner demon's oath.
But now, Li Hanshan actually "will talk about it later"!
"Did my charm fail? It’s impossible…”
She was puzzled, but she didn't show it and continued to play the role of a gentle and considerate little slave girl.
Li Hanshan felt the doubts and anger in her heart, and the corners of his mouth rose slightly.
This witch had been plotting against him for so long, and she finally felt what it felt like to be plotted against.
However, Hua Nongying quickly adjusted her mentality.
"It doesn't matter, the secret realm is the key. "
She sneered in her heart: "You think you can escape from my grasp if you don't help me build the foundation? As long as you enter the secret realm, I see how you can escape! "
